name: api-change
title_zh: API 层改动先列全影响面再动手的变更单
tagline_zh: 改一个端点，怕漏了鉴权、响应结构、前端契约？它把请求参数、错误处理、数据写入逐项摊开，逼你逐条确认，改完不返工。
tagline_en: Changing one endpoint but afraid of missing auth, response shape, or frontend contract? It lays out params.
desc_en: Use for API Layer changes, including endpoints, request parameters, response structures, authentication, error handling, service logic, data writes, and frontend/backend contracts.
why_zh: 不是模板填空，而是按依赖顺序生成检查清单，先服务逻辑后数据写入，每项都要求你给出现状与目标。
why_en: Not a fill-in template—it generates a dependency-ordered checklist, service logic before writes, demanding current & target per.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 API 层改动，不含数据库迁移脚本、消息队列消费者或前端组件实现；产物是影响面清单与确认记录。
limit_en: API-layer changes only. No DB migrations, queue consumers, or frontend component code. Output is an impact checklist & sign-off, not code patches.
title_en: API change impact list before you touch code
